segments.title: Cold Open & Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official network sign-on and countdown; Case Blackwell joins for the live countdown.

segments.title: Opening Banter & Hype Train Confusion
segments.notes: Case and Pepito discuss the 30-minute pre-Patreon window; Hype Train is active but Case refuses to acknowledge it; Pepito goes missing from his seat.

segments.title: Technical Difficulties & Pepito Returns
segments.notes: Case troubleshoots Pepito's absence; Pepito reappears claiming he was 'being the Hype Train'; Pepito demands 'Stream Pope' title and a talk show.

segments.title: Trailer Thursdays: Elden Ring Nightreign & One Piece
segments.notes: Case and Trent (parole officer bit) react to Elden Ring Nightreign trailer with Evanescence track; One Piece Season 2 announcement trailer at Netflix's 'Tudum' event.

segments.title: Trailer Thursdays: House of Kong, Titan, K-pop Demon Hunters
segments.notes: Quick reactions to House of Kong teaser, Ocean Gate disaster documentary 'Titan', and Netflix animated film K-pop Demon Hunters; frame-rate debate ensues.

segments.title: Red Light Confusion & Filler How-To Segment
segments.notes: Case mistakes the exit light for a wrap signal; Jeb Nogget is missing so random how-to videos play: muscle flexing, 'minimus' dance, Mickey Mouse pose — Kendall appears in the dance clips.

segments.title: Stream Close & Raid
segments.notes: Case ends stream early; viewer Jake helps Kendall with grammar; raid intended for Ricky Peacock / Christine.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a rushed 30-minute pre-Patreon broadcast; runs Trailer Thursdays and filler how-to segments; does 'Trent' parole officer bit.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers sign-on; disappears then claims he was impersonating Hype Train; demands 'Stream Pope' title and a talk show.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype announcer. Active on secondary screen; Pepito falsely claims to be Hype Train in a costume; Case refuses to acknowledge the hype train.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: parole officer bit. Case's recurring character at the movies desk; claims to be a parole officer who doesn't believe in the state.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appears in pre-recorded how-to dance clips (minimus, Mickey Mouse); Case watches to be polite.

characters.name: Jake
characters.notes: call-in guest. Viewer who helps Kendall write a past-tense honorific message at stream end.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: recurring. Referenced as missing and possibly dead; his 'How To with Jeb' segment is skipped.

lore_notes.fact: Claims to have been impersonating Hype Train on the secondary screen while absent from producer seat.
Campaigns for on-air title 'Stream Pope' and demands Case build him a talk show.
Confirmed missing; Case says 'apparently he's dead or something' and doesn't know who he is.
Produces how-to dance content (minimus, Mickey Mouse pose) under the 'How To' branding while Jeb is absent.

episode_summary: A truncated 30-minute pre-Patreon broadcast where Case Blackwell rushes through trailer reactions (Elden Ring Nightreign, One Piece Season 2, K-pop Demon Hunters) and filler how-to segments while Jeb Nogget remains missing; Pepito briefly impersonates Hype Train and campaigns for a 'Stream Pope' title; the stream ends with a grammar assist from a viewer named Jake and a raid toward Ricky Peacock.
